scenario.topic: Pick a mural design for the community sports hall
scenario.opening_question: What aspects matter most when choosing a mural for the sports hall—community identity, visual impact, maintenance, or cost?

options.name: Local Sports Legends Portraits
options.upside: Honors well-known athletes from the community, boosting local pride
options.tradeoff: Limited appeal to younger children who may not recognize the figures
options.concern: Some may feel it excludes newer or less famous athletes
options.best_for: celebrating community heritage and inspiring youth

options.name: Dynamic Action Sports Scenes
options.upside: Creates energetic and visually engaging imagery that motivates players
options.tradeoff: Higher maintenance due to detailed paintwork and vibrant colors
options.concern: May feel too generic or busy for some community members
options.best_for: energizing the space and appealing to active sports participants

options.name: Abstract Geometric Sports Patterns
options.upside: Modern and timeless design that is easy to maintain and update
options.tradeoff: Less direct representation of sports or community identity
options.concern: Might feel impersonal or disconnected from local culture
options.best_for: low maintenance and contemporary aesthetic preferences

options.name: Youth Sports Diversity Collage
options.upside: Highlights inclusivity and represents all age groups and sports
options.tradeoff: Complex design may require more upkeep and careful cleaning
options.concern: Some may find the collage visually overwhelming or cluttered
